_meta.structure: Organised by Kip module id. Every section carries a source_url pointing at the official page the facts came from.

steps: Activate OSHC health cover (it should start from your arrival date)
Get an Australian SIM card (major networks: Telstra, Optus, Vodafone; budget: Amaysim, Boost)
Open a bank account (or activate the one you opened from overseas)
Apply for your TFN at ato.gov.au (needed before your first payday)
Get your transport concession card through your university
Register your Australian address with your education provider within 7 days
Attend your university orientation and international student welcome
Save the emergency number 000 and Healthdirect 1800 022 222

student_500.name: Student Visa (Subclass 500)

work_rights.note: Breaching the 48-hour limit is a visa condition breach and may affect your visa

key_conditions: Must remain enrolled in and actively studying a registered CRICOS course
Must maintain Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for the duration of your visa
Must notify your education provider of address changes within 7 days

graduate_485.name: Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485)
graduate_485.description: Live, study and work in Australia after completing your studies
graduate_485.deadline: Must apply within 6 months of receiving final results

skilled_pathways.subclass_189: Skilled Independent (permanent, points-based, min 65 points, no sponsor)
skilled_pathways.subclass_190: Skilled Nominated (permanent, state nomination adds 5 points, 2-year commitment to state)
skilled_pathways.subclass_491: Skilled Work Regional (provisional 5 years, +15 points, pathway to PR via 191 after 3 years)
skilled_pathways.professional_advice: For visa strategy, consult a MARA-registered migration agent: https://www.mara.gov.au

tfn.name: Tax File Number (TFN)
tfn.description: A unique 9-digit number for tax and superannuation. Free, never expires.
tfn.how_to_apply: Apply online at ato.gov.au once you are in Australia
tfn.without_tfn: 47% withholding tax applies to your wages
tfn.never_share: Only share your TFN with the ATO, your employer (after you start), your bank, or your super fund

income_tax.name: Income Tax (2024-25 resident rates)
income_tax.residency_note: Tax residency is different from visa residency — many students ARE Australian residents for tax purposes if they stay 6+ months in one place. Check the ATO residency tool.
income_tax.lodge_return: Lodge at my.gov.au (myTax) each year by 31 October. Financial year runs 1 July – 30 June.

superannuation.name: Superannuation (Super)
superannuation.eligibility: All employees with work rights are entitled to super from the first dollar earned

dasp.name: Departing Australia Superannuation Payment (DASP)
dasp.description: Claim your super back after you permanently leave Australia and your visa has ended
dasp.tax_rate: 65% withholding for most temporary visa holders (35% for working holiday makers)

minimum_wage.name: National Minimum Wage
minimum_wage.award_note: Many industries have higher award rates — check fairwork.gov.au/pay

rights.name: Your Work Rights
key_rights: At least minimum wage for every hour worked, regardless of visa
A payslip within 1 working day of pay day
A safe workplace, free from discrimination and harassment

underpayment_help.visa_protection: Fair Work has an agreement with Home Affairs: your visa will not be cancelled for reporting workplace exploitation

finding_a_place.name: Where to search for rentals

trusted_platforms.name: flatmates.com.au
trusted_platforms.best_for: Share houses and rooms — usually the most affordable option

finding_a_place.policy: Kip links students to live search results on these trusted platforms. Kip never invents or quotes individual listings — always check the live site.

renting_process.name: Renting in Australia
typical_requirements: Proof of income or savings (bank statements)

upfront_costs.bond: Usually 4 weeks rent — held by the state bond authority, NOT the landlord
upfront_costs.total: Budget about 6 weeks rent to move in

renting_process.bond_protection: Your bond must be lodged with your state's bond authority. You get it back at the end if there is no damage or unpaid rent.
renting_process.scam_warning: Never transfer money before inspecting a property in person and signing a lease. Report rental scams to scamwatch.gov.au

oshc.name: Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)
oshc.requirement: Mandatory for all student visa holders for the full visa duration
oshc.covers: Hospital, limited GP visits, ambulance, some prescriptions
oshc.tip: Ask clinics: 'Do you bulk bill OSHC?' — some GPs charge no gap for OSHC holders

medicare.name: Medicare
medicare.student_eligibility: Most student visa holders are NOT eligible for Medicare
medicare.rhca_exception: Citizens of RHCA countries (UK, Ireland, NZ, Sweden, Netherlands, Finland, Italy, Belgium, Malta, Slovenia, Norway) may get some Medicare benefits

bank_accounts.name: Opening a Bank Account
bank_accounts.before_arrival: Major banks (CommBank, ANZ, Westpac) let you open an account online up to 3 months before arriving
bank_accounts.student_accounts: All big four banks offer no-monthly-fee student accounts — compare features at moneysmart.gov.au
bank_accounts.sending_money_home: Compare transfer providers' full cost (fee + exchange rate margin) at moneysmart.gov.au before choosing — over-the-counter bank transfers are usually the most expensive option

melbourne.concession: Concession myki for eligible full-time students; free CBD tram zone

brisbane.concession: Concession go card for eligible students

perth.concession: Concession for eligible students; free CAT buses in CBD

concessions_by_city.note: Apply for concession status through your university — international student eligibility varies by state

discounts.unidays: Verify with your .edu.au email for discounts on tech, clothing, food

budgeting.share_room_weekly: Sydney $300-420 · Melbourne $260-360 · Brisbane $220-310 · Perth $240-340 · Adelaide $180-280 · Hobart $160-280
budgeting.tip: ALDI and marked-down items at Coles/Woolworths after 7pm stretch a student budget

support.university_support: Every university has a free international student support office — use it for visa, housing, academic and personal issues

common_scams.name: Scams targeting international students
common_scams.visa_scam: Callers claiming to be Home Affairs/police demanding payment to avoid visa cancellation or arrest. Government agencies NEVER demand payment by phone, gift cards or crypto. Hang up.
common_scams.rental_scam: Landlords asking for bond/rent before you inspect. Never pay before seeing the property and signing a lease.
common_scams.job_scam: Jobs requiring you to pay upfront or receive/forward money through your bank account (money muling is a crime).

safety.legal_note: Kip gives general guidance from official sources — not legal, migration or financial advice. For visa decisions use a MARA-registered agent (mara.gov.au); for legal issues contact your university's student legal service.
